criteria.title: Role badge displays for facility user with doctor role
criteria.blocker: Backend API does not return user_type field - all users have undefined user_type causing empty badge. API returns role_orgs array but implementation expects user.user_type (UserType). Badge element renders but {t(user.user_type)} evaluates to empty string.

criteria.title: Role badge shows Administrator for care-fac-admin
criteria.blocker: Same root cause as AC1 - user.user_type undefined in API response. Tested with care-fac-admin credentials, dropdown opens correctly showing name and username, but badge element is empty. API returns role_orgs with Facility Admin role but no user_type field.

criteria.title: Profile navigation works with role badge visible
criteria.blocker: Badge empty before and after Profile navigation due to missing user_type field. Profile navigation itself works correctly (navigates to /facility/{id}/users/admin), but acceptance criterion requires badge to be visible which it is not. Badge remains empty throughout the flow.

criteria.title: Logout works with role badge present
criteria.blocker: Logout functionality works (redirects to /login, clears session) but badge is not present with content as criterion requires. Badge element exists but is empty due to undefined user_type. Core logout flow not broken, but badge requirement not met.

criteria.title: Patient nav menu has no role badge
criteria.blocker: Patient OTP login not available in fixture data. Requires phone number + OTP generation + backend SMS infrastructure. No test patient credentials in setup-notes or tests/.auth/patient.json. Code inspection shows PatientNavUser correctly does not render Badge component.

seed_attempt.summary: Reviewed qa-plan Data setup - patient login requires OTP flow with phone number. No fixture patient credentials available. Backend load_fixtures provides facility users (care-doctor, care-fac-admin, etc.) but not OTP-enabled patient accounts. Skipped UI attempt as login form requires valid OTP.
